name: Atari STE
description: A deterministic representative 16-colour sample of the Atari STE's extended 4-bit-per-channel (16 x 16 x 16 = 4096 total colours) hardware RGB DAC, using the same hue layout as the atari-st palette at the STE's deeper colour precision. Like the ST, the STE displays 16 of its total colour space simultaneously in standard low-resolution modes; this is a representative sample, not a captured ROM palette.
